description:
Create or replace the store's webhook: one HTTPS endpoint that receives the store's events as they happen. Each delivery is POST {id, type, created_at, data} with header X-Webhook-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed with the webhook's whsec_ secret. Creating returns the secret ONCE — store it where the endpoint verifies signatures. Replacing keeps the secret (no secret in the result) and turns back on a webhook that was disabled after repeated failures. Needs account credentials (a session or CHAINDADDY_API_KEY), never a store key.

Params: store_id, url (https://…), events? (subset of iap.order.created|paid|confirmed|expired|reverted|refunded|mismatch|duplicate_payment, iap.entitlement.granted|consumed|revoked|expiring|expired, iap.drop.claimed|awarded|exhausted, iap.sku.sold_out, iap.store.not_live|live; omit for all), session_token?
Returns: {ok, webhook: {id, url, events, active, createdAt, lastTriggeredAt, secret?}} (secret only when created)
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, SESSION_REQUIRED (a store key), HTTP_400 (bad url or event), HTTP_404

events.description: Only these events; omit for all

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_set_webhook
title: Set store webhook
